en.headline: DFI to take over Asia Starbucks as Maxim's buys back stake
en.dek: The Wellcome and Mannings parent will receive more than 1,100 licensed coffeehouses plus about US$340 million in cash, with completion targeted by early 2027.
body: DFI Retail Group said on Wednesday it had agreed a reorganisation of its 50 per cent interest in Maxim's Caterers, under which it will take over Maxim's licensed Starbucks business in seven Asian markets and receive about US$340 million in cash.

Maxim's, which is also 50 per cent owned by the Wu family's Hongkong Caterers, will buy back DFI's shares. The Starbucks licensed network covers more than 1,100 coffeehouses in Thailand, Hong Kong, Singapore, Vietnam, Cambodia, Macau and Laos. DFI said the business reported revenue of about US$750 million in 2025 with an underlying operating margin of 7 per cent.

The Singapore-listed group, controlled by Jardine Matheson, said the coffee business would be immediately revenue and margin accretive to its core retail operations and that it would raise its 2027 dividend payout ratio to 80 per cent. The transaction remains subject to customary completion conditions and is expected to close by the end of the first quarter of 2027.

DFI said day-to-day operations of both the Starbucks licensed stores and Maxim's restaurants would continue unchanged after completion, and that the parties would keep working together on procurement, supply chain, property and digital matters.

zh.headline: DFI讓出美心股權換星巴克亞洲業務及3.4億美元
zh.dek: 惠康及萬寧母企將承接七個市場逾1,100間特許星巴克，並收取約3.4億美元現金，料2027年首季完成。
body: DFI零售集團星期三公布，將重組所持美心食品五成股權：美心向其回購股份，DFI則承接美心在亞洲七個市場的星巴克特許經營業務，並收取約3.4億美元現金。
美心另一半股權由胡氏家族的香港食品有限公司持有。有關星巴克網絡涵蓋泰國、香港、新加坡、越南、柬埔寨、澳門及老擾逾1,100間咖啡店。DFI表示，該業務2025年錄得約7.5億美元營業額，基本經營利潤率為7%。
由怡和控股的DFI指，星巴克業務將即時為核心零售帶來營業額及利潤率貢獻，並把2027年派息比率提升至80%。交易仍須符合慣常完成條件，預計2027年第一季完結前落實。
DFI表示，完成後星巴克特許店及美心食肆的日常營運維持不變，雙方會繼續在採購、供應鏈、物業及數碼範疇合作。
